questions.explanation: 根据前文“交通突然停止”可推断，George此时是“注意到”了前方发生事故。noticed符合语境，表示察觉、注意到。
questions.supplement:
A(noticed)：语境句：I noticed a strange smell when I entered the room. 固定搭配：notice sb doing sth, take notice of
B(survived)：语境句：He survived the terrible car accident. 固定搭配：survive on, survive from
C(avoided)：语境句：She crossed the street to avoid meeting him. 固定搭配：avoid doing sth, try to avoid
D(caused)：语境句：The heavy rain caused a massive flood. 固定搭配：cause damage, cause sb to do

questions.explanation: 根据语境，Healy识别出起火迹象，且接下来他“ran forward(向前跑)”，说明他迅速从车里“跳出来”。sprang out意为“跳出，跃出”，符合紧急救援的动作表现。
questions.supplement:
A(turned around)：语境句：He turned around and walked away without a word. 固定搭配：turn around, turn sth around
B(pulled away)：语境句：The train slowly pulled away from the station. 固定搭配：pull away, pull out
C(sprang out)：语境句：He sprang out of bed when the fire alarm rang. 固定搭配：spring out of, spring up
D(slowed down)：语境句：The car slowed down as it approached the school. 固定搭配：slow down, slow down growth

questions.explanation: Healy跑向事故发生的地方，这里通常被称为“事故现场(scene)”。
questions.supplement:
A(highway)：语境句：Driving on the highway requires full attention. 固定搭配：on the highway, highway construction
B(scene)：语境句：The police quickly arrived at the scene of the crime. 固定搭配：at the scene, behind the scenes
C(town)：语境句：He grew up in a small town in the south. 固定搭配：home town, out of town
D(destination)：语境句：We reached our destination after a long flight. 固定搭配：tourist destination, final destination

questions.explanation: 到达现场后，Healy迅速“评估/判断”了局势(judged the situation)，从而意识到有人被困。
questions.supplement:
A(judged)：语境句：You shouldn't judge a book by its cover. 固定搭配：judge from/by, judge the situation
B(transformed)：语境句：The internet has completely transformed the way we communicate. 固定搭配：transform into, transform society
C(controlled)：语境句：The brave firefighters finally controlled the fire. 固定搭配：under control, out of control
D(reported)：语境句：The journalist reported the news accurately. 固定搭配：it is reported that, report to sb

questions.explanation: 结合后文“find the man who had passed out(晕倒)”可知，驾驶座上的男子已经失去了知觉。senseless在此处意为“失去知觉的，不省人事的”，符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(inconsistent)：语境句：His actions are inconsistent with his promises. 固定搭配：be inconsistent with, highly inconsistent
B(inflexible)：语境句：The manager is quite inflexible about the working hours. 固定搭配：inflexible rules, highly inflexible
C(senseless)：语境句：The boxer was knocked senseless in the first round. 固定搭配：beat senseless, completely senseless
D(hopeless)：语境句：The situation seemed completely hopeless at first. 固定搭配：feel hopeless, hopeless at doing sth

questions.explanation: 由句意可知，车门因撞击而变形，以致于Healy只能打破车窗爬进去。bent out of shape 是固定表达，意为“扭曲变形”。
questions.supplement:
A(sight)：语境句：The ship gradually sailed out of sight. 固定搭配：catch sight of, out of sight
B(balance)：语境句：He lost his balance and fell off the ladder. 固定搭配：keep balance, lose balance
C(reach)：语境句：Keep the medicine out of the reach of children. 固定搭配：within reach, out of reach
D(shape)：语境句：The car was completely bent out of shape in the crash. 固定搭配：out of shape, in good shape

questions.explanation: Healy爬进车内寻找那个晕倒且“被困”的男子。trapped(被困的)常用于形容事故中人员无法脱身的危险处境。
questions.supplement:
A(trapped)：语境句：Several miners were trapped underground after the explosion. 固定搭配：be trapped in, feel trapped
B(covered)：语境句：The mountains were heavily covered with snow. 固定搭配：be covered with/in, cover up
C(seated)：语境句：Please remain seated until the plane comes to a complete stop. 固定搭配：be seated, remain seated
D(wrapped)：语境句：The Christmas gift was beautifully wrapped in red paper. 固定搭配：be wrapped in, wrap up

questions.explanation: 车内充满浓烟，大火“威胁(threatened)”要吞噬整辆车。threaten to do sth 表示“有做某事的危险或预兆”，生动地描绘了火势蔓延的危急。
questions.supplement:
A(expected)：语境句：She is expected to win the gold medal this year. 固定搭配：expect sb to do, be expected to do
B(managed)：语境句：They managed to finish the challenging project on time. 固定搭配：manage to do, manage a team
C(threatened)：语境句：The dark clouds threatened heavy rain. 固定搭配：threaten to do, pose a threat to
D(waited)：语境句：We waited anxiously for the final exam results. 固定搭配：wait for, wait and see

questions.explanation: 在陌生人的帮助下，Healy“最终(eventually)”解救了被困男子并将他拉出燃烧的车。强调经过一番努力后的结果。
questions.supplement:
A(personally)：语境句：The manager personally apologized to the disappointed customer. 固定搭配：personally speaking, take it personally
B(eventually)：语境句：After trying many times, he eventually succeeded. 固定搭配：eventually become, eventually lead to
C(initially)：语境句：Initially, I didn't like the plan, but changed my mind later. 固定搭配：initially appear, initially plan
D(hardly)：语境句：I can hardly hear what you are saying because of the noise. 固定搭配：hardly ever, can hardly

questions.explanation: 结合语境，男子获救后火势更加严重，这说明救援进行得“非常及时(just in time)”，差一点就有生命危险。
questions.supplement:
A(at ease)：语境句：His friendly smile made me feel completely at ease. 固定搭配：feel at ease, put sb at ease
B(at risk)：语境句：His poor diet and lack of exercise put his health at risk. 固定搭配：put at risk, be at risk
C(in case)：语境句：Take an umbrella with you just in case it rains. 固定搭配：in case of, just in case
D(in time)：语境句：Fortunately, the ambulance arrived just in time to save him. 固定搭配：in time for, just in time

questions.explanation: 前文提到“I've devoted 34 years of firefighting service”，所以是这34年的“经验(experience)”告诉他如果不采取行动，人就会死。
questions.supplement:
A(passion)：语境句：She has a strong passion for classical music. 固定搭配：passion for, have a passion
B(experience)：语境句：His rich experience helped him solve the tricky problem. 固定搭配：learn from experience, gain experience
C(duty)：语境句：It is our duty to protect the fragile environment. 固定搭配：sense of duty, off duty
D(nature)：语境句：It is human nature to want to be loved and understood. 固定搭配：by nature, human nature

questions.explanation: Healy冒着生命危险冲进火海救人，这种行为显然是“英勇的(heroic)”。
questions.supplement:
A(heroic)：语境句：The firefighter was awarded a medal for his heroic actions. 固定搭配：heroic action, heroic deed
B(tough)：语境句：The team is facing a very tough opponent in the final. 固定搭配：tough time, tough decision
C(direct)：语境句：Is there a direct flight from Beijing to New York? 固定搭配：direct contact, direct impact
D(sympathetic)：语境句：She was very sympathetic to my difficult situation. 固定搭配：be sympathetic to/towards, feel sympathetic

questions.explanation: 同事评价Healy：遇到麻烦时，他总是第一个去“响应/应对(respond)”的人。这也符合他消防员迅速反应的职业素养。
questions.supplement:
A(agree)：语境句：I totally agree with your brilliant and creative idea. 固定搭配：agree with, agree to do
B(respond)：语境句：The government needs to respond quickly to the economic crisis. 固定搭配：respond to, respond with
C(lead)：语境句：A good captain should know how to lead the team to victory. 固定搭配：lead to, lead a life
D(succeed)：语境句：If you work hard and never give up, you will eventually succeed. 固定搭配：succeed in doing, succeed to

questions.explanation: 同事认为这只是他敬业精神的又一个例子，因此这对大家来说“不足为奇 (it is no shock)”。shock在这里表示令人震惊的事物。
questions.supplement:
A(secret)：语境句：They kept their marriage a secret for two long years. 固定搭配：keep a secret, in secret
B(challenge)：语境句：Learning a completely new language can be a huge challenge. 固定搭配：face a challenge, accept a challenge
C(concern)：语境句：Global climate change is a major concern for scientists. 固定搭配：express concern, cause for concern
D(shock)：语境句：The sudden news of his resignation came as a huge shock. 固定搭配：come as a shock, in shock

questions.explanation: 当一切结束后，Healy和他的家人虽然晚了一点，但“继续(continued)”了他们的旅程。
questions.supplement:
A(missed)：语境句：I woke up late this morning and missed the early bus. 固定搭配：miss the chance, miss the point
B(postponed)：语境句：The outdoor concert was postponed due to the heavy rain. 固定搭配：postpone doing, be postponed until
C(continued)：语境句：After a short break, they continued their heated discussion. 固定搭配：continue to do, continue doing
D(reviewed)：语境句：Students should regularly review their notes before the final exam. 固定搭配：review lessons, review a book

vocab_pack.definition_en: to stop moving or operating
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中came是come的过去式，表示过去发生的动作；a sudden stop是名词短语，包含形容词sudden修饰stop，表示“突然停下”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The bus came to a stop at the red light.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 公交车在红灯处停了下来。
vocab_pack.from_passage: traffic came to a sudden stop

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become aware of an accident happening
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中noticed是notice的过去式，与宾语an accident构成动宾短语，表示过去观察到的事故。
vocab_pack.example_en: He noticed an accident on his way to work.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他在上班途中注意到了一起事故。
vocab_pack.from_passage: he noticed an accident ahead

vocab_pack.definition_en: to identify or be aware of the indications of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中Recognizing是recognize的现在分词，构成分词短语作状语，表示主动识别动作与谓语动词几乎同时发生。
vocab_pack.example_en: She recognized the signs of a storm and took shelter.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她识别出了暴风雨的迹象并躲避起来。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Recognizing the signs of a fire

vocab_pack.definition_en: to jump or move quickly out of somewhere
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中sprang是spring的过去式，表示瞬间的动作，out为副词，构成短语动词。
vocab_pack.example_en: The cat sprang out from behind the sofa.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 猫从沙发后面跳了出来。
vocab_pack.from_passage: sprang out and ran forward

vocab_pack.definition_en: to move quickly ahead in a forward direction
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中ran是run的过去式，forward为副词表示方向，整体描述过去的一个动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: The soldier ran forward to help his comrade.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 士兵向前跑去帮助他的战友。
vocab_pack.from_passage: sprang out and ran forward

vocab_pack.definition_en: as soon as arriving at a place or a point in time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: Upon为介词，后接动名词reaching，表示“在到达……的时候”，用作时间状语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Upon reaching the station, he bought a ticket.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 一到车站，他就买了票。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Upon reaching the scene

vocab_pack.definition_en: to arrive at the place where something (e.g., an accident) happened
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中reaching是reach的动名词，the scene为宾语，构成动名词短语作介词upon的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The police reached the scene within five minutes.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 警察在五分钟内到达了现场。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Upon reaching the scene

vocab_pack.definition_en: badly harmed or injured in terms of condition
vocab_pack.grammar_note: seriously为副词修饰形容词damaged（过去分词作定语），共同修饰vehicles，表示车辆受损程度。
vocab_pack.example_en: The building was seriously damaged in the earthquake.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该建筑在地震中严重受损。
vocab_pack.from_passage: two seriously damaged vehicles

vocab_pack.definition_en: having a layer of something on the surface
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中covered为过去分词，in为介词，构成短语表示“被…所覆盖”，作后置定语修饰engine。
vocab_pack.example_en: The ground was covered in snow.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 地面被雪覆盖。
vocab_pack.from_passage: with the engine of one car covered in intensifying fire

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become greater, more serious, or more extreme
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中intensifying为现在分词作定语，修饰fire，表示“正在变得更加强烈的火”，具有主动和进行含义。
vocab_pack.example_en: The storm intensified as it approached the coast.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 暴风雨接近海岸时加剧了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: intensifying fire

vocab_pack.definition_en: to form an opinion or assessment about the current circumstances
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中judged是judge的过去式，与宾语the situation构成动宾短语，表示过去做的判断。
vocab_pack.example_en: We must judge the situation carefully before making a decision.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在做出决定前我们必须仔细判断形势。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Healy quickly judged the situation

vocab_pack.definition_en: unconscious; lacking sense or awareness
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中senseless作主语补足语（a man was senseless），说明主语的状态，系动词was后接形容词。
vocab_pack.example_en: He was knocked senseless by the blow.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他被那一下打晕了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a man was senseless in the driver's seat

vocab_pack.definition_en: the seat in a vehicle where the driver sits
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为名词短语，作介词in的宾语，表示位置。所有格driver's表明是驾驶员的座位。
vocab_pack.example_en: Please sit in the passenger seat, not the driver's seat.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 请坐在副驾驶座，不要坐驾驶座。
vocab_pack.from_passage: in the driver's seat

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become physically distorted or deformed
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中bent是bend的过去分词，与was构成被动语态，表示车门被弄弯变形。out of shape为固定短语作主语补足语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The metal bar was bent out of shape after the crash.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 金属棒在碰撞后弯曲变形了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The car door was bent out of shape

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause a window to shatter or crack
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中broke是break的过去式，与宾语the window构成动宾短语，表示过去的动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: The thief broke the window to get inside.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 小偷打破窗户进入里面。
vocab_pack.from_passage: so Healy broke the window

vocab_pack.definition_en: to get into something (e.g., a vehicle) by climbing
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中climbed是climb的过去式，into为介词，构成短语动词，表示通过攀爬进入车内。
vocab_pack.example_en: The child climbed into the tree house.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 孩子爬进了树屋。
vocab_pack.from_passage: climbed into the car

vocab_pack.definition_en: to lose consciousness
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中had passed out是过去完成时，passed为过去分词，out为副词，表示在另一个过去动作之前已经发生（先昏迷）。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many people passed out from the heat.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多人因高温昏倒了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the man who had passed out trapped

vocab_pack.definition_en: to catch or confine someone in a place from which escape is difficult
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中trapped为过去分词，作宾语补足语，与the man构成find + object + past participle结构，表示发现某人被困。
vocab_pack.example_en: The miners were trapped underground for days.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 矿工们被困在地下好几天。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the man who had passed out trapped

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become full of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中was filling是过去进行时，fill的现在分词filling与with构成短语，表示车内正逐渐充满烟雾。
vocab_pack.example_en: The room was filling with smoke from the fire.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 房间正逐渐充满火灾的烟雾。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The car was filling with smoke

vocab_pack.definition_en: to indicate an intention to do something harmful or unwelcome
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中threatened是threaten的过去式，后接不定式to consume，表示“火有吞没整辆车的危险”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The storm threatened to destroy the crops.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 暴风雨有摧毁庄稼的危险。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the fire threatened to consume the entire vehicle

vocab_pack.definition_en: to completely destroy or use up (e.g., by fire)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中consume为不定式，与to构成动词不定式短语，作threatened的宾语，表示“将要完全烧毁”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The fire consumed the entire building.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 大火烧毁了整栋建筑。
vocab_pack.from_passage: threatened to consume the entire vehicle

vocab_pack.definition_en: the whole car or transport unit
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为名词短语，作consume的宾语，entire为形容词修饰vehicle，表示“整个车辆”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The entire vehicle was damaged in the accident.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 整辆车在事故中受损。
vocab_pack.from_passage: consume the entire vehicle

vocab_pack.definition_en: assisted by someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中With the help of为介词短语作状语，表示行为发生的方式，a stranger为介词of的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: With the help of my friends, I finished the project.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在朋友们的帮助下，我完成了项目。
vocab_pack.from_passage: With the help of a stranger

vocab_pack.definition_en: to set free from confinement or restraint
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中released是release的过去式，与宾语the man构成动宾短语，表示过去完成的解救动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: The firefighters released the trapped driver from the wreck.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 消防员将受困司机从残骸中解救出来。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Healy eventually released the man

vocab_pack.definition_en: to move someone or something towards oneself or to a different position
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中pulled是pull的过去式，与him构成动宾短语，from介词短语表示方向，整体描述将人从车中拉出的动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: The rescuer pulled the victim out of the water.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 救援者将受害者从水中拉出。
vocab_pack.from_passage: pulled him from the burning car

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be on fire or consume by fire
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中burning为现在分词作定语，修饰car，表示“正在燃烧的汽车”，具有主动和进行含义。
vocab_pack.example_en: The burning building was evacuated quickly.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 燃烧的建筑物被迅速疏散。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the burning car

vocab_pack.definition_en: at the last moment; almost too late
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为固定短语作状语，修饰pulled out的动作，表示在最后一刻完成救援。
vocab_pack.example_en: The ambulance arrived just in time to save the patient.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 救护车刚好及时到达救下了病人。
vocab_pack.from_passage: just in time

vocab_pack.definition_en: great love, loyalty, or dedication to a person or cause
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为名词，作介词of的宾语，短语his devotion指代Healy的奉献精神。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her devotion to her family is admirable.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她对家庭的奉献令人钦佩。
vocab_pack.from_passage: another example of his devotion

vocab_pack.definition_en: not surprising to someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中no shock to为固定短语，it作主语，is为系动词，us为介词to的宾语，表示“对我们来说并不意外”。
vocab_pack.example_en: His resignation was no shock to anyone.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他的辞职对任何人来说都不意外。
vocab_pack.from_passage: it is no shock to us

vocab_pack.definition_en: to resume traveling after a break
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中continued是continue的过去式，their journey为宾语，表示他们继续了旅行（尽管晚了一些）。
vocab_pack.example_en: After a short rest, they continued their journey.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 短暂休息后，他们继续了旅程。
vocab_pack.from_passage: continued their journey

section_2_word_form.passage:
Exploring the beauty and tradition of Chinese calligraphy was both challenging and uplifting for a Canadian. As the brush touched the paper, a world that was whole new to me [56] before my eyes, and every stroke (笔画) carried rich history and far-reaching meaning, connecting me to a culture so deeply [57] in art and expression.
At that moment, as I engaged in my first attempt at [58] Chinese calligraphy, it was not merely about writing Chinese characters, [59] about appreciating a heritage (遗产) that transforms what initially seemed like just an art lesson [60] a great spiritual awakening.
The ink (墨水) danced on the paper, representing centuries of tradition and culture essential to the Chinese [61] . Each stroke told a story, a tale of the hands of people that had come before me, [62] a piece of their soul in every character. The beautiful movements required accuracy as well as discipline, qualities that I realized [63] crucial in art and life itself. Laying down the brush, I was hit by a sense of peace, [64] made me believe that the experience would forever be carved in my memory, becoming a reminder of the [65] of Chinese calligraphy.

questions.explanation: 考查时态和语态。句子主语是 a world，主句缺乏谓语，根据上下文时态(touched)可知发生在过去。reveal可表示“展现”，用主动表被动(revealed)或被动语态(was revealed)均可。
questions.supplement: 正确形(revealed)：语境句：The shocking truth was finally revealed to the public. 固定搭配：reveal a secret, reveal oneself。原词reveal其它变形：revelation(n. 揭示), revealing(adj. 暴露的)。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。固定搭配 be rooted in (扎根于...)，此处作后置定语修饰 a culture，省略了 that is，故用过去分词 rooted。
questions.supplement: 正确形(rooted)：语境句：His love for nature is deeply rooted in his childhood memories. 固定搭配：be deeply rooted in, take root。原词root其它变形：rootless(adj. 无根的)。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词/动名词。attempt at doing sth 意为“尝试做某事”，介词 at 后需接动名词。impress 在此引申为“印下、刻印(写)”，即尝试书写中国书法。（注：若从词性转换角度视为形容词修饰名词，也可填 impressive，但结合后文 writing 动作，用动名词更符合动作属性）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(impressing/impressive)：语境句：She gave an impressive performance on stage. 固定搭配：attempt at doing sth, make an impression。原词impress其它变形：impressive(adj. 给人深刻印象的), impression(n. 印象)。

questions.explanation: 考查连词。固定句型 not merely... but (also)...，意为“不仅……而且……”，连接平行的介词短语 about writing 和 about appreciating。
questions.supplement: 正确形(but)：语境句：He is not merely a great writer, but a brilliant painter. 固定搭配：not merely... but (also), nothing but, all but。

questions.explanation: 考查介词。固定搭配 transform A into B，意为“把A转变成B”，此处将一堂艺术课转变成了精神上的觉醒。
questions.supplement: 正确形(into)：语境句：The tiny caterpillar eventually transformed into a beautiful butterfly. 固定搭配：transform into, turn into, change into。

questions.explanation: 考查名词复数。native 作为名词表示“本地人”，the Chinese natives 意为“中国当地人/中国人”。因指代群体，需用复数形式。
questions.supplement: 正确形(natives)：语境句：The island is home to many friendly and welcoming natives. 固定搭配：native speaker, native language。原词native其它变形：natively(adv.)。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。主句谓语是 told，逗号后需用非谓语作伴随状语。主语 Each stroke (或 hands) 与 leave 之间是主动关系，故用现在分词 leaving。
questions.supplement: 正确形(leaving)：语境句：The storm quickly passed, leaving a trail of destruction behind. 固定搭配：leave behind, leave alone。原词leave其它变形：left(过去式/过去分词)。

questions.explanation: 考查主谓一致与时态。that 引导定语从句修饰 qualities(复数)，从句中缺谓语动词；且主句动词为 realized(过去时)，故填 were。
questions.supplement: 正确形(were)：语境句：The new skills he learned were very useful in his career. 固定搭配：be crucial to, be crucial in。

questions.explanation: 考查定语从句。逗号后为非限制性定语从句，指代前面的整句话（或 a sense of peace），在从句中作主语，故填关系代词 which。
questions.supplement: 正确形(which)：语境句：He finally passed the exam, which made his parents very happy. 固定搭配：in which, from which。

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换。在定冠词 the 之后、介词 of 之前，需使用名词。deep 的名词形式是 depth，意为“深度”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(depth)：语境句：We were completely amazed by the depth of his historical knowledge. 固定搭配：in depth, the depth of。原词deep其它变形：deeply(adv. 深深地), deepen(v. 加深)。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to search or travel for the purpose of discovery
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动名词形式作主语，表示主动的探索行为。
vocab_pack.example_en: Exploring ancient ruins helps us understand history.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 探索古代遗迹有助于我们理解历史。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Exploring the beauty and tradition of Chinese calligraphy

vocab_pack.definition_en: difficult in a way that tests your ability or determination
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作表语，与was构成系表结构，描述主语的性质。
vocab_pack.example_en: The final exam was challenging yet rewarding.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 期末考试很有挑战性，但也很有收获。
vocab_pack.from_passage: was both challenging and uplifting

vocab_pack.definition_en: making you feel more hopeful or happy
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 鼓舞人心的，令人振奋的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作表语，与challenging并列，构成系表结构。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her uplifting speech inspired everyone in the room.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她那鼓舞人心的演讲激励了房间里的每个人。
vocab_pack.from_passage: was both challenging and uplifting

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make physical contact with the surface of paper
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，主动语态，主谓宾结构，描述笔触的动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: As the brush touched the paper, the ink spread smoothly.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 当毛笔触碰到纸张时，墨水均匀散开。
vocab_pack.from_passage: As the brush touched the paper

vocab_pack.definition_en: completely new; entirely different
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词短语修饰名词a world，文中用作表语（后置）的一部分，实际为was whole new to me中的定语成分。
vocab_pack.example_en: Studying abroad opened up a whole new world for me.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 出国留学为我打开了一个全新的世界。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a world that was whole new to me

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be completely unfamiliar or new to someone
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 对某人来说完全陌生/全新
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时，系表结构，主语a world，介词to引出对象。
vocab_pack.example_en: The concept of calligraphy was whole new to the foreign student.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 书法的概念对这个外国学生来说是全新的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: was whole new to me

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make something known or visible that was hidden
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时被动语态，主语a world，by短语省略，表示世界被展现。
vocab_pack.example_en: The hidden path was revealed after the storm.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 暴风雨后隐藏的小路显露了出来。
vocab_pack.from_passage: was revealed before my eyes

vocab_pack.definition_en: in someone's direct view; as someone watches
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作状语，修饰动词revealed，表示方位。
vocab_pack.example_en: The entire cityscape unfolded before our eyes.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 整个城市景观在我们眼前展开。
vocab_pack.from_passage: was revealed before my eyes

vocab_pack.definition_en: to contain or convey a deep historical significance
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，主动语态，主语every stroke，动词carry的过去式。
vocab_pack.example_en: Ancient artifacts carry rich history that scholars study for decades.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 古代文物承载着学者们研究几十年的丰富历史。
vocab_pack.from_passage: every stroke carried rich history

vocab_pack.definition_en: having a wide and significant influence or effect
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复合形容词修饰名词meaning，作定语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The industrial revolution had far-reaching social effects.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 工业革命产生了深远的社会影响。
vocab_pack.from_passage: rich history and far-reaching meaning

vocab_pack.definition_en: to establish a link or relationship with something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语作状语，表示伴随动作，逻辑主语为前文的动作过程。
vocab_pack.example_en: Music connects people to their cultural roots.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 音乐将人们与他们的文化根源联系起来。
vocab_pack.from_passage: connecting me to a culture

vocab_pack.definition_en: firmly established and deeply ingrained in something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去分词短语作宾语补足语或定语，修饰culture，表示文化深深根植于艺术和表达。
vocab_pack.example_en: His beliefs are deeply rooted in traditional values.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他的信仰深深植根于传统价值观。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a culture so deeply rooted in art and expression

vocab_pack.definition_en: exactly at the time referred to
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作时间状语，修饰整个句子。
vocab_pack.example_en: At that moment, I understood the power of kindness.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 就在那一刻，我明白了善良的力量。
vocab_pack.from_passage: At that moment, as I engaged in my first attempt

vocab_pack.definition_en: to take part in or become involved in an activity
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，主动语态，主语I，后接介词in的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Students are encouraged to engage in community service.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 鼓励学生参与社区服务。
vocab_pack.from_passage: as I engaged in my first attempt

vocab_pack.definition_en: an effort or try to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，at后接动名词短语，表示尝试的内容。文中first修饰attempt。
vocab_pack.example_en: This is my first attempt at painting a portrait.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这是我第一次尝试画肖像画。
vocab_pack.from_passage: my first attempt at impressing Chinese calligraphy

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to emphasize that something is more than just the first thing mentioned
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 不仅……而且……（强调后者更重要）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 并列结构，连接两个介词短语，表示对比递进。
vocab_pack.example_en: Education is not merely about knowledge, but about character.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 教育不仅关乎知识，更关乎品格。
vocab_pack.from_passage: it was not merely about writing Chinese characters, but about appreciating a heritage

vocab_pack.definition_en: to recognize the value or significance of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动名词形式作介词about的宾语，表示欣赏的行为。
vocab_pack.example_en: We should learn to appreciate different cultures.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们应当学会欣赏不同的文化。
vocab_pack.from_passage: about appreciating a heritage

vocab_pack.definition_en: to change something completely into something else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，第三人称单数，主语that（指代heritage），后接宾语从句。
vocab_pack.example_en: A good teacher transforms a boring lesson into an exciting adventure.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 一位好老师能把枯燥的课变成一场激动人心的冒险。
vocab_pack.from_passage: transforms what initially seemed like just an art lesson into a great spiritual awakening

vocab_pack.definition_en: to appear to be or give the impression of being
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，系动词seem的过去式，后接like引导的表语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The mountain seemed like a giant sleeping in the distance.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那座山看起来像远处沉睡的巨人。
vocab_pack.from_passage: what initially seemed like just an art lesson

vocab_pack.definition_en: a class or session in which art is taught
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作介词like的宾语，前面有不定冠词an。
vocab_pack.example_en: We had an interesting art lesson on watercolor painting.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们上了一堂有趣的水彩画美术课。
vocab_pack.from_passage: just an art lesson

vocab_pack.definition_en: a profound realization or renewal of spiritual awareness
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作介词into的宾语，前面有形容词great修饰。
vocab_pack.example_en: Meditation can lead to a spiritual awakening.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 冥想可以带来精神觉醒。
vocab_pack.from_passage: into a great spiritual awakening

vocab_pack.definition_en: to move rhythmically in a lively, often graceful way (used figuratively here)
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 跳舞（文中为比喻用法，意为轻盈飘动）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，主动语态，主语The ink，比喻墨水在纸上流动如舞。
vocab_pack.example_en: The candle flames danced in the dark room.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 烛火在黑暗的房间里舞动。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The ink danced on the paper

vocab_pack.definition_en: to serve as a symbol or embodiment of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语作状语，表示伴随或补充说明，逻辑主语是The ink。
vocab_pack.example_en: The dove represents peace in many cultures.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 鸽子在许多文化中代表和平。
vocab_pack.from_passage: representing centuries of tradition and culture

vocab_pack.definition_en: absolutely necessary or extremely important for something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词短语作后置定语，修饰tradition and culture，表示对中国人本质上重要。
vocab_pack.example_en: Water is essential to all living things.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 水对所有生物都至关重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: tradition and culture essential to the Chinese natives

vocab_pack.definition_en: to narrate or convey a tale or history
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，主动语态，主语Each stroke，tell的过去式。
vocab_pack.example_en: Every old photograph tells a story of its time.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 每张老照片都讲述着它那个时代的故事。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Each stroke told a story

vocab_pack.definition_en: to exist or occur earlier than someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去完成时，表示过去的过去，主语people，后接before引出时间点。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many great scientists had come before Newton.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在牛顿之前有许多伟大的科学家。
vocab_pack.from_passage: people that had come before me

vocab_pack.definition_en: in addition to; and also
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 并列连词，连接accuracy和discipline，表示两者都重要。
vocab_pack.example_en: The course covers theory as well as practice.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这门课程涵盖理论和实践。
vocab_pack.from_passage: accuracy as well as discipline

vocab_pack.definition_en: extremely important or essential in a particular context
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词短语作表语（后置），修饰qualities，后面接介词in引出领域。
vocab_pack.example_en: Teamwork is crucial in achieving project goals.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 团队合作对实现项目目标至关重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: crucial in art and life itself

vocab_pack.definition_en: to put something down in a careful or deliberate way
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语作状语，表示时间，逻辑主语为I，相当于When I laid down。
vocab_pack.example_en: He laid down the book and closed his eyes.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他放下书，闭上了眼睛。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Laying down the brush

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be suddenly affected by a strong feeling or physical force
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时被动语态，主语I，by后接a sense of peace表示被平静感击中。
vocab_pack.example_en: I was hit by a wave of nostalgia as I entered the old house.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 走进老房子时，我涌起一阵怀旧之情。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I was hit by a sense of peace

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause someone to have a particular belief or opinion
vocab_pack.grammar_note: make + 宾语 + 不带to的不定式，一般过去时，主语which（指代peace）。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her kindness made me believe in the goodness of people.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她的善良让我相信人性的美好。
vocab_pack.from_passage: made me believe that the experience would forever be carved in my memory

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be permanently remembered or impressed upon someone's mind
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动语态（含情态动词would），carve的过去分词，表示经历将被永久铭刻。
vocab_pack.example_en: The scenic view will be carved in my memory forever.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那美丽的景色将永远铭刻在我的记忆中。
vocab_pack.from_passage: would forever be carved in my memory
